mapper.select: SELECT ips.id pool_status_id ,ips.adjust_log_id ,ips.security_code ,ips.security_short_name ,ips.security_type old_security_type ,si.security_type new_security_type FROM ip_pool_status ips INNER JOIN rrs_securityinfo si ON si.wind_code = ips.security_code INNER JOIN dict_security_type old_type ON old_type.security_type = ips.security_type AND old_type.category_type = 'bond' AND old_type.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN dict_security_type new_type ON new_type.security_type = si.security_type AND new_type.category_type = 'bond' AND new_type.is_deleted = 0 WHERE ips.is_deleted = 0 AND ips.audit_status = '20' AND ips.security_type != si.security_type ORDER BY ips.id ASC
